name: avalara-returns
title: Avalara Returns
summary: Provides access to Avalara Global Returns APIs for tax returns, filing calendars, and compliance data
description: Avalara Returns MCP server gives AI agents access to Avalara Global Returns / Managed Returns capabilities including supported countries and tax types, tax forms, and filing calendars. Use it to automate returns discovery and filing preparation.

useCases.name: Supported returns countries and tax types
useCases.description: Discover which countries, regions, and tax types Managed Returns supports so agents can guide filing scope decisions.

useCases.name: Tax form discovery
useCases.description: List tax forms with codes, regions, and associated tax types for a country or region to prepare returns work.

useCases.name: Filing calendar retrieval
useCases.description: Retrieve filing calendars for a company to understand upcoming return due dates and filing obligations.

avalaraReturnsOauth.description: Authenticate with Avalara using OAuth2 authorization code flow.
